name: Goji Berry
siboNotes: Goji berries are well-tolerated in small amounts and their dense nutrient profile makes them a valuable addition to SIBO-friendly diets.
preparationTips: Stick to 1 tablespoon serving size to maintain low FODMAP status
Can be eaten dried as a snack or soaked in water to soften
Add to low FODMAP smoothies or sprinkle on lactose-free yogurt
Store in airtight container in cool, dry place to maintain freshness
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
Good source of vitamin A and zeaxanthin for eye health
Contains complete protein with all essential amino acids
